description: This page from the Helmholtz Metadata Collaboration's Energy Hub lists the standards, languages, vocabularies and ontologies that the Helmholtz Association recommends for energy research, in an alphabetical list with a short description and a read-more link for each entry. Entries seen include the AEMET Network of Ontologies for Spanish weather data, the Basic Formal Ontology, the Common Information Model (IEC 61970, 61968 and 62325), CityGML metadata extensions, DCAT, Digital Object Identifiers, DOLCE, Dublin Core, an IEC series for data transmission, the Open Energy Ontology and Open Energy Metadata, SUMO and the W3C OWL Time Ontology. The Energy Hub asks users to share how they work with these standards and to suggest missing ones. Coverage is energy research in Germany, with international standards. Access: free web page, no licence stated. Caveats: a curated list of references, not the standards themselves. It suits metadata and interoperability planning for energy datasets, and relates to the Open Energy Ontology and IEC 61970-301 CIM records catalogued here.
